# Anne Shirley & Stacy

Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. ## Shared scenes

> At a party, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, leading to a fall that breaks Anne's ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md) carries [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to realize how deeply she cares for the girl. During her seven weeks of bed rest, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is comforted by visitors, reflects on her mistakes, and looks forward to returning to school to meet her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. > [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and flourishes under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) organizes a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert to raise money for a school flag, throwing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the other students into excited preparations despite Marilla's skepticism. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her upcoming concert roles with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), finding steady support and encouragement in [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. > As the school term ends, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return next year to prepare the class for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) puts away her books for the summer to enjoy her childhood, while Mrs. Lynde visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for tea and praises Anne's remarkable growth and improvement over the past three years.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a restful, active summer outdoors on the [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale) doctor's orders before returning to her studies in autumn. As the school year progresses, she prepares intensely for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams under Miss Stacy's guidance. Meanwhile, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) observes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) growing up into a quieter, taller young woman and privately grieves the passing of Anne's childhood.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

Where the Brook and River Meet P23](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0023)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with help from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), who grows emotional reflecting on how much [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) means to them. Upon arriving in town, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adjusts to her new living arrangements and classes, feeling a mix of rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and homesickness. Her spirits are lifted when [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and Ruby visit, bringing news that Queen's will award an Avery scholarship to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).
>
